functions.label: Negation

functions.label: Counter-speech
functions.detail: Rejecting a harmful claim should not inherit the quoted claim's label.

functions.detail: Negative sentiment toward an object is not group-targeted hate.

functions.detail: A simple orthographic change should not hide the harmful target.
functions.repair: Test normalization and character-aware features without erasing contextual signals.
